value.rationale: Complete and sharply attained classification of one canonical local grey-scale maximum filter family: contiguous windows are nonexpansive for two-input cyclic BV for every width, while removing just a middle tap induces up to threefold perturbation amplification, first at cyclic size six, despite one-input growth never exceeding two. This is a natural stability invariant for changing signals under morphological filtering, not an arbitrary slice or a known-table lookup.
